source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U14: Separate winding-up authority and post-dissolution public-notice liability

payload.title: Dissolution does not instantly erase every authority or debt
payload.core_explanation_md:
Authority can continue for winding up and completing transactions begun but unfinished at dissolution under the described rule. This does not authorise starting unrestricted new business under the old mandate. Establish the purpose and timing of the proposed act.

Public notice also matters to the specified third-party liability for later acts, with exceptions including the described deceased or insolvent estate and certain unknown retired partners. Do not announce that every estate is liable until notice or that dissolution cancels existing firm debts. A recovery file needs the dissolution evidence, notice history, unfinished transactions and creditor position.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a winding-up power be treated as unrestricted authority for new trading?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Its purpose and statutory limits matter.

payload.stem_md: After dissolution, a partner signs a fresh unrelated trading contract and relies only on winding-up authority. What is the key question?

options.text_md: Whether the paper uses the old letterhead
Whether the partner still remembers the password
Whether all old debts are automatically cancelled
options.explanation_md: Dissolution has no such blanket effect.

options.text_md: Whether the act is genuinely within winding up or completion of an unfinished transaction

payload.stem_md: A notice asserts that every deceased partner estate is liable for all later firm acts until public notice. What is wrong?

options.explanation_md: Notice is relevant in the qualified framework.

options.text_md: It ignores the statutory exceptions to the post-dissolution liability rule
options.explanation_md: The deceased-estate qualification cannot be erased.

options.text_md: Every estate automatically becomes a new partner
All later transactions are necessarily void
options.explanation_md: That blanket conclusion is not established.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The deceased-estate qualification cannot be erased.
